items.difficulty_reason: The counted lemma is the author lemma at source lines 2058-2062: if a Delta_0 sentence is true in the standard model then Q proves it. The author proof (2064-2133) is an induction on formula complexity whose induction step splits into nine explicitly enumerated cases: four propositional cases discharged by the induction hypothesis plus logic, four bounded-quantifier cases routed through the Q-provable equivalence between a bounded quantifier and a finite conjunction or disjunction of numerals instances, and a final negation case that falls back to atomic completeness or strips a double negation. Keeping the truth-in-the-standard-model side and the provability side aligned across all nine cases, and seeing which cited lemma each bounded-quantifier case needs, is a substantial bookkeeping argument rather than a routine verification.
